testsuite.name: com.carecompanion.app.fixes.OutboxStoreConcurrencyTest

testcase.name: a corrupt undecodable entry is dropped rather than retried forever
item enqueued while flush is in-flight is not erased
flush retains on server failure then fully drains once the server recovers
pendingCount reflects exactly the number of queued items
